{{Top|leg}}
'''Inthulpin''' was the name of the [[Spring/Legends|spring]] season on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draenell's Point]]. Inthulpin lasted for fourteen [[Standard month/Legends|months]]&mdash;a quarter of Draenell's Point's [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] cycle&mdash;as a local [[Standard year/Legends|year]] was 4.2 standard years.
